column1: # console-oracle cases: libSceUserService argument handling and error codes.
# Every call that returns a user id or name carries `redact`: the payload prints only the buffer's
# length, never its contents, so no id or name is ever written to a file. Only return codes are kept.
# No sceUserServiceTerminate: the payload may share the loader's user service session. No
# sceUserServiceGetInitialUser either: it fails inside the payload process (which is not a game), so
# its result would describe the harness and not the console.
